$Comment: The essence quest: life essence is what a lucky, practised woodcutter shakes loose from a log
on top of the planks, and this quest asks for it in numbers.
find_essence counts essence the Sawmill hands over (STATION_OUTPUT, exact id, qualified to the
Sawmill, so essence from any other source does not count); deliver_essence is Order 2, an
exact-id hand-in to Marn. Requires carries a Woodcutting level gate beside the stations
feature, one step on the chain's own level curve: it sits below the level the last rung asks
for, so the two read as a climb rather than a wall. Keep it under that figure if you retune
either. The pack's find ladder opens its deeper tiers higher still, which leaves the richest
essence something to grow into rather than something this quest hands over. Rewards: a personal
Woodcutting boost token (the Mmo_Boost_Token kind: Skill, Multiplier, DurationMinutes) and XP.
Name: Deep_In_The_Wood
